settings.body: Oud Fury lasted through an entire flight and was still there when I landed. Compliments the whole way.
settings.author: Farah I.

settings.body: Agha Blue is my go-to for the office. Close enough to be noticed, never loud in a small room.
settings.author: Yusuf T.

settings.body: Maha is soft and grown-up. My mother borrowed the bottle once and I still haven't gotten it back.
settings.author: Priya V.

settings.body: Ordered Sea Smoke as a gift and the packaging alone made it feel like a proper present.
settings.author: Omar Z.

settings.quote: I wore Oud Fury to a winter wedding and three people asked what it was before the first dance.
settings.name: Arjun M.

settings.quote: Agha Blue feels like cold air after rain. It is the one I reach for on hot, crowded days.
settings.name: Sara K.

settings.quote: Maha is soft without being sweet. My mother borrowed it once and never gave it back.
settings.name: Noor A.

settings.quote: Dark Paradise is my evening scent. Smoky, close to the skin, never loud.
settings.name: Rehan S.

settings.quote: Sea Smoke has been in my carry-on for every trip this year. Clean, salty, easy to wear.
settings.name: Meera P.

settings.quote: Tobacco Enigma is warm and green at the same time. I did not expect to love tobacco this much.
settings.name: Kabir D.

settings.quote: Shamamah smells like a garden in the late afternoon. It is the bottle guests always pick up first.
settings.name: Layla H.
